name: GPU Isosurface Raycasting of FCC Datasets
aliases: FCC Raycasting, Six-Direction Box-Spline Raycasting on FCC
definition: An efficient and accurate isosurface rendering algorithm for natural C1 splines on the face-centered cubic (FCC) lattice, leveraging fast evaluation of the spline field and its gradient, efficient empty-space skipping, and a novel indexing scheme for 3D texture storage.
summary: GPU Isosurface Raycasting of FCC Datasets renders volume data on a Face-Centered Cubic lattice using six-direction cubic box-splines, offering better sampling efficiency than Cartesian methods and superior cache performance along the z-axis compared to BCC raycasting.
